msItem.incipit: na mo gu ru many+ju g+ho ShA ya/ rmad byung thugs rjes bskyod pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag blo'i pad+mo legs par kha phye nas/ /byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun bla ma deng 'dir dge legs stsol/ /lhun stug bai DUr+ya yi ri bo ni/ /rnam bkra gser sbyangs zhun mas 'khyud pa bzhin/ /rab brjid 'khor lo'i mgon po yab yum gyi/ /zhabs sen srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog de la 'dud//
msItem.explicit: ces bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas rtsa ba'i rgyud las byung ba bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyas 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi rgya cher bshad pa de kho na nyid snang ba'i snying po bsdus pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i rnga no che rgyun mar sgrog cing / /bslab pa gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi mngon par rtogs pas rgyud phyug pa'i mdo sngags rab 'byams pa mang po la zin thun du byas pa zin bris su mdzad pa rnams ha cang dag par mi 'dug pas/ dngos kyis dag por bgyis pa zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba dang / bstan pa'i rtsa lag chos kyi gdan khri 'dzin pa'i dam pa du mas kyang bskul ba la brten nas/ /chos smra ba blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis chos grwa chen po bkra shi lhun po 'i gzims khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams pa dar ma bzang po 'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig/ /eka pRts+tsha/ /sar+ba mang+ga laM//
